method: Fifty ordered scenario-driven reviews across source suppression, static native API access, configuration, baseline/selection and model field contracts. Each pairs source inspection with an executable probe and a valid-state control. Replays validate repairs; synthetic scenarios and reused corpora are not independent reviewers or independent precision observations.

boundaries: Dynamic runtime API discovery with unproved module identity remains outside static proof.
Explicitly selected analyses and whole-path exclusions remain scope choices, not certificates of a full gate.
New model-reader findings remain warnings under the required warning-first lifecycle.

validation.typechecks: Python rule/source facts and Standards integration passed

verification.canonical_result: Final source passes doctor, generated docs/build, formatting, lint, both dogfood scans, all package typechecks and the TypeScript/bootstrap/contracts/Python/SQL/IaC suites. Fresh-wheel Standards tests initially had 19 failures: six existing case-insensitive-filesystem fixtures and thirteen missing-offline-cache Zizmor failures. All thirteen setup failures pass in a fresh-wheel replay after restoring the exact pinned tool cache. The six remaining fixture failures are independently reproduced against unchanged initial main sources.

baseline_reproduction.source: unchanged initial main, archived outside Git and explicitly selected through PYTHONPATH
baseline_reproduction.cause: The case-insensitive macOS filesystem treats view.TSX as the existing tracked view.tsx file; the fixture changes that file instead of creating the distinct case-sensitive filename it expects.

additional_commands.result: passed; private-reference scanning is delegated to trusted CI; ShellCheck reports existing SC2310 warnings

verification.release_state: Local changes only; SARJ522 remains warning-stage and there is no autofix. A release and consumer upgrade are required to apply the new gate to existing pull requests.
